p4 text  x=64.7 y=428.7 Courier/9 "function greet(name) {" #000000
p4 text  x=64.7 y=440.7 Courier/9 "    return `Hello, ${name}!`;" #000000
p4 text  x=64.7 y=452.7 Courier/9 "}" #000000
p4 text  x=64.7 y=464.7 Courier/9 " " #000000
p4 text  x=64.7 y=476.7 Courier/9 "const result = greet(\"Világ\");" #000000
p4 text  x=64.7 y=488.7 Courier/9 "console.log(result);" #000000
p4 rect  x=56.7 y=516.7 w=481.9 h=88.0 fill=#F5F5F5 stroke=#C8C8C8/0.5
p4 text  x=64.7 y=524.7 Courier/9 "def greet(name):" #000000
p4 text  x=64.7 y=536.7 Courier/9 "    \"\"\"Üdvözlő függvény\"\"\"" #000000
p4 text  x=64.7 y=548.7 Courier/9 "    return f\"Hello, {name}!\"" #000000
p4 text  x=64.7 y=560.7 Courier/9 " " #000000
p4 text  x=64.7 y=572.7 Courier/9 "if __name__ == \"__main__\":" #000000
p4 text  x=64.7 y=584.7 Courier/9 "    print(greet(\"Világ\"))" #000000
p4 rect  x=56.7 y=612.7 w=481.9 h=124.0 fill=#F5F5F5 stroke=#C8C8C8/0.5
p4 text  x=64.7 y=620.7 Courier/9 "SELECT " #000000
p4 text  x=64.7 y=632.7 Courier/9 "    u.name," #000000
p4 text  x=64.7 y=644.7 Courier/9 "    COUNT(o.id) as order_count" #000000
p4 text  x=64.7 y=656.7 Courier/9 "FROM users u" #000000
p4 text  x=64.7 y=668.7 Courier/9 "LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id" #000000
p4 text  x=64.7 y=680.7 Courier/9 "WHERE u.created_at > '2024-01-01'" #000000
p4 text  x=64.7 y=692.7 Courier/9 "GROUP BY u.id" #000000
p4 text  x=64.7 y=704.7 Courier/9 "HAVING order_count > 5" #000000
p4 text  x=64.7 y=716.7 Courier/9 "ORDER BY order_count DESC;" #000000
p5 rect  x=56.7 y=56.7 w=481.9 h=76.0 fill=#F5F5F5 stroke=#C8C8C8/0.5
p5 text  x=64.7 y=64.7 Courier/9 "#!/bin/bash" #000000
p5 text  x=64.7 y=76.7 Courier/9 "echo \"Hello World\"" #000000
p5 text  x=64.7 y=88.7 Courier/9 "for i in {1..5}; do" #000000
p5 text  x=64.7 y=100.7 Courier/9 "    echo \"Iteration $i\"" #000000
p5 text  x=64.7 y=112.7 Courier/9 "done" #000000
p5 rect  x=56.7 y=140.7 w=481.9 h=100.0 fill=#F5F5F5 stroke=#C8C8C8/0.5
